A '''binding chair''' is a type of ''[[ter'angreal]]'' made during the Age of Legends. It is unknown whether any have survived the [[Breaking of the World]].

==Appearance==
As no binding chairs have been revealed, it is unknown what the exact appearance of them are.

==Use==
These ''ter'angreal'' could be used to bind non-channelers to oaths, such as the [[Oath Rod]] does for those who can channel.
